scope: SDK#1: supply an egui-winit clipboard backend and construct State with it, plus exclusive mutable access on the epaint mutex wrapper. Synthetic in-memory tests only.
implemented: ClipboardBackend: Send with get/set_text/set_image; Sync is not required from the backend.
Clipboard::from_backend(Box<dyn ClipboardBackend>) selects the custom backend without constructing the system backend; None remains None without fallback.
State::new_with_clipboard(context, viewport_id, clipboard, native_pixels_per_point, theme, max_texture_side) has no display-target argument.
Default Clipboard::new and State::new keep their existing default-backend path.
epaint::Mutex::get_mut uses an exclusive reference without acquiring the lock; clipboard backend operations use it.

verification.authority: Root-run local Cargo, Clippy, rustdoc and rustfmt results retained in the final metadata; this documentation task did not rerun them.
verification.test_count_scope: The x11/default/wayland matrix repeats related tests under different feature configurations; its counts are not summed as distinct tests.
coverage: Custom text return and text/image dispatch exactly once, with exact non-square dimensions and pixel data.
A custom None result does not use an in-app or OS fallback.
Root/secondary viewport configuration, context identity, native pixels per point, theme, texture limit and State text routing.
Clipboard Send+Sync and RefUnwindSafe when the clipboard feature is disabled, with a Send but non-Sync backend fixture.
Mutable epaint mutex access before and after a scoped lock.

result.mutation: Preserve get dispatch but discard its result and return None. No OS clipboard access.
result.result: Expected synthetic string became None; one targeted test failed. Not an inherited defect.

verification.independent_review: cache_design_review: zero material blockers on exact final sources; no Cargo/native actions by reviewer

compatibility.owned_unwind_safe_note: Custom backend type erasure no longer promises owned Clipboard: UnwindSafe. The static API change is documented; this is not full auto-trait compatibility.

remaining: SDK#2: NativeOptions clipboard factory and failure/reset behavior in WGPU/Glow root, secondary and immediate viewport creation.
Nonblocking opt-in paste request/response with destination lifetime and focus correlation.
Shared Wayland clipboard/DnD device ownership and exact-surface routing in limn.
Native clipboard/SDK interoperability QA, approved SDK and limn pins, and the RUNE consumer.
limits: Synthetic in-memory clipboard tests only, no OS clipboard or real window runtime.
